description.zh_cn: 瞬间把一段轨道的颜色改到目标色，不带过渡
description.en_us: Instantly recolor a section of the track to a target color, with no transition

text.zh_cn: 第 1 章 · 概览 {SetTrackColor} 与 {RecolorTrack} 字段完全一样，但 没有 {duration}、没有 {ease}： 事件触发的瞬间，范围内的 {tile} 直接跳到目标色。 用途：关卡开始时给一段轨道定一个静态底色。
text.en_us: Chapter 1 · Overview {SetTrackColor} takes exactly the same fields as {RecolorTrack}, but has no {duration} and no {ease}: The moment the event fires, the {tile}s in {range} jump directly to the target color. Use it to set a static base color at the start of a level.

text.zh_cn: 第 2 章 · vs {RecolorTrack} 两次 {RecolorTrack} 都需要 {duration} 渐变； {SetTrackColor} 省略 了 {duration}，单帧完成。 下面先后演示两种：先 {SetTrackColor}（无渐变），再 {RecolorTrack}（平滑渐变）。
text.en_us: Chapter 2 · vs {RecolorTrack} {RecolorTrack} always needs {duration} to transition. {SetTrackColor} omits {duration} and completes in one frame. We demo both: {SetTrackColor} first (no transition), then {RecolorTrack} (smooth).

text.zh_cn: 第 3 章 · 范围与跳格 与 {RecolorTrack} 相同： {startTile} / {endTile} 决定 {range}，{gapLength} 决定哪些 {tile} 染色。
text.en_us: Chapter 3 · Range & gap Same as {RecolorTrack}: {startTile} / {endTile} set the {range}; {gapLength} picks which {tile}s get colored.
